name: Love Letter
description: A romantic handwritten letter experience with an opening envelope, two love letter pages, floating hearts, and a little celebration.
features: Light / dark theme + colour palette selector

templateLimits.note: This template is text-only. No photo uploads. Editor must hide the image gallery field.

pageOneSubtitle.label: Page one subtitle
pageOneSubtitle.default: If my heart could write, it would write about you...

pageOneBody.label: Page one letter
pageOneBody.default:
Hey, my love... 💗

There are so many things I wish I could tell you, but sometimes words feel too small for what my heart wants to say.

So today, I wanted to give you something a little different. A tiny piece of my heart, written just for you.

If you're reading this, imagine me sitting beside you, holding your hand, smiling at you for no reason at all.

Because honestly, you have become one of my favourite parts of life.

And if there's one thing I hope you never forget, it's this...

You are so, so special to me. More than these little words could ever explain. 🌷

pageTwoTitle.label: Page two title
pageTwoTitle.default: Things My Heart Wants You To Know

pageTwoSubtitle.label: Page two subtitle
pageTwoSubtitle.default: A little love letter, just for you...

pageTwoBody.label: Page two letter
pageTwoBody.default:
My sweetest love,

If I could give you one thing in this world, I would give you the ability to see yourself through my eyes.

Maybe then, just for a moment, you would understand how precious you are to me, how your smile can make an ordinary day feel beautiful, and how simply having you in my life means more than you know.

I don't need every day to be perfect. I don't need a world full of grand gestures or a thousand beautiful promises.

I just want the little things with you.

And if life ever gets too loud, I hope you remember this little letter.

Somewhere in this big world, there is a heart that is genuinely happy you exist.

finalLine.label: Final closing line
finalLine.default: If I could write a thousand letters, I would still have more love to say.
